disorder-name.detail: Major depressive disorder; patients diagnosed by experienced psychiatrists based on DSM-IV criteria, without comorbid psychiatric disorders or current substance use
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Patients received diagnoses from experienced psychiatrists based on the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders-IV (DSM-IV) criteria for MDD, without comorbidities with other psychiatric disorders or current substance use."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Discovery dataset from DIDA-MDD Working Group (9 sites, N=1148 MDD); Validation dataset from REST-meta-MDD consortium (25 sites, N=1276 MDD). Total N=2424 MDD patients.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "two large multi-center datasets, comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 healthy controls sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium"

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from two datasets. Discovery (DIDA-MDD): N=1148, mean=33.83, SD=14.97. Validation (REST-meta-MDD): N=1276, mean=36.23, SD estimated as 13.78. Note: SD values show discrepancies between sources. Table S1 reports Discovery SD=14.97; main text reports 22.17. For Validation, Table S1 shows '213.78' (apparent OCR artifact); main text reports 21.378. Table S1 values (14.97 and estimated 13.78) used for pooled SD calculation as they appear more internally consistent. Min/max age not reported.
age.supporting_text: "1148 patients with MDD (age: 33.83 ± 22.17 years)"; "1276 patients diagnosed with MDD (age: 36.23 ± 21.378 years)"; Table S1: Discovery MDD Age 33.83 (14.97); Validation MDD Age 36.23 (213.78)
age.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples, L77, L85; S0033291724002617sup001.docx.md: Table S1, L49-50

sex.detail: Combined across two datasets. Discovery (DIDA-MDD): Female=673, Male=475 (N=1148, Female 58.6%). Validation (REST-meta-MDD): Female=813, Male=463 (N=1276, Female 63.7%). Total: Female=1486, Male=938 (N=2424). Percentages derived from combined counts.
